retrievalProfile.description: A minimalist high-key layout featuring a centered subject on a stark white field with expressive, hand-drawn marker typography in a single vibrant color.
excludeWhen: dark or moody lighting is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A bright, high-key composition where a small-scale subject is anchored at the bottom of a vast white canvas, topped by large-scale, textured marker-style script in a primary blue hue.
coreVisualRelationships: Extreme contrast between the vast white negative space and the saturated blue typography
Vertical hierarchy placing text at the top and the subject at the bottom
Visual weight balance between the large, airy script and the detailed, small-scale figure
Cohesion between the blue text and the denim/cool-toned elements of the subject
coreInvariants: Pure white background with no visible horizon line
Hand-drawn marker texture on all typography
Subject positioned in the lower third of the frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered in the lower 30% of the frame, appearing small relative to the total canvas size.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's seated pose and the horizontal line of the floor create a stable base.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large blue text at the top, travels down through the white space, and rests on the subject at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Approximately 70% of the composition is empty white space, emphasizing the subject and text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white background for maximum brightness.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant cobalt blue for all typographic elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Natural skin tones and striped patterns on the subject's clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, low-saturation background contrasted with high-saturation, medium-value typography.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to white, blue, and natural subject colors

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with a slight rightward slant
letterConstructionRules: Simulated felt-tip marker strokes with visible dry-brush texture
Jagged, non-uniform edges on all characters
Connected lowercase letters with detached uppercase initials
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase letters feature aggressive, sweeping flourishes
Lowercase 'i' dots are small, irregular circles
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-style script used for both primary and secondary text, varied only by scale.
graphicDevices: None; the typography acts as the primary graphic element.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the raw, felt-tip aesthetic and stroke weight.
Provides the necessary slant and casual energy.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key studio portrait of a subject in 80s fashion (e.g., striped shirt, denim) seated on a white floor against a seamless white background. Ensure the subject occupies only the bottom third of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom marker-style script in cobalt blue at the top of the frame. Use a dry-brush texture for the strokes and maintain a casual, hand-written appearance.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure white without shadows?
Does the text have a visible marker-like texture?
Is the subject correctly scaled to the bottom third?
Is the blue color vibrant and consistent?

mustRedesign: Avoid exact likeness of the original artist
Do not use the specific brand name or title from the reference
postGenerationChecks: Check for seamless white background integration
Verify marker stroke jitter and texture
Confirm color saturation of the blue text
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key studio portrait + [Subject Description] + [Bottom-Third Placement] + [Top-Aligned Marker Script] + [Cobalt Blue Color Palette]
